primary_comparator.source_quality: author-reported summary; replicate-level numerical curves unavailable; not a recalled product

interpretation: Both unfitted scenario medians underpredict the single reported endpoint by about 10 percentage points, and it lies above both assumption-scenario p95 values. The quantiles are not predictive intervals. This flags model/assumption discrepancy; it does not establish product-level model failure, validate or refute the publication, or support recalibration from n=1.

secondary_comparator.reason: PDF text extraction showed missing/inconsistent time-row cell counts and nonmonotonic profile values; table cell alignment and source values were not independently resolved

paper_1_internal_kinetic_fit_conflict.interpretation: Internal reporting discrepancy; do not claim independently reproduced fit.

limitations: one author-reported numerical endpoint only; no replicate-level curve or SD
different research formulation, not Glenmark or Ajanta recalled batches
scenario distributions are assumed parameter draws, not confidence or predictive intervals
no training/fitting or parameter tuning to the literature endpoint
no experimentally validated candidate or approved QC method/specification
